A '''red dwarf''' [[Star/Legends|star]] was located in the [[UR-5292-FH system/Legends|UR-5292-FH system]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. [[Jaden Korr]] and [[Marr Idi-Shael]] followed a [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical supply ship]] filled with the [[Community]] of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] and the captured [[Khedryn Faal]] to the system with the red dwarf. It cast the cockpit of [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Junker'']] a crimson [[Color/Legends|color]].
